treatment: One unchanged repo mode reference (empirical.md or theory.md) in addition to identical task, model, budget, inputs and tools. Tests document guidance only.
primary: Whole-paper recovery per prewritten source-specific rubric and standalone quality. One run per arm per paper. No causal success-rate estimate.
requested_deliverable: Complete self-contained LaTeX paper, analysis when applicable, actual uncertainty and gaps, recognition disclosure.
model: use same installed Codex CLI default and reasoning medium; verify actual run records
budget: 480 wall seconds per author; deadline failures count. No author rerun after viewing scores.
selection: Two purposively selected accessible AER papers. One already-used empirical calibration with later raw survey access; one theory RQ and model primitives only. No open search or external files for authors. Both run pairs in fresh contexts.
review: Review anonymized papers for scientific quality before seeing arms and reference answers, then assess historical fidelity. Funding/API charge unobserved; log duration and tokens when available.
